lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hello, this is the Missilis Research...

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You've turned my daughter into a monster! How can you sleep at night?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You told her she'd become just like one of the Goddess Squad! How can you even deceive a little girl like her?! (Sobs)

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We have no way of anticipating the results of any experiment...

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'm going to sue you to kingdom come, regardless of how it costs me!
